comment: Missing-scope checklists per venue archetype (phase E4, v0.7.0). Each entry: zone_prefix matches the catalog zone letter prefix (zone string before the first '-'); catalog_ids (optional any-of) pins must-have unit cards inside the prefix. An entry is satisfied when the estimate carries at least one labor line whose catalog zone matches the prefix (and, when catalog_ids is set, at least one of the listed ids). Missing entries are HARD findings (config/sanity.json severity.missing_scope) and block the approved transition.
